theorem_level_results.terminally_anchored_homogeneous_guide: For every finite exact-r=1 segment x_0,...,x_N, define g_s=x_N*(2/3)^(N-s). Then g_s-x_s=sum_{j=s}^{N-1}(c_j/3)*(2/3)^(j-s), so 0<=g_s-x_s<19 for every s<=N.
theorem_level_results.terminal_boundary_localization: If x_s and g_s have different leading-digit sectors, some decimal boundary C=d*10^k lies in (x_s,g_s], hence 0<=g_s-C<19.

interpretation: The forward normalized corridor from PR #17 and this terminally anchored guide are complementary. The forward coordinate keeps (2/3)^s x_s inside a fixed width-19 interval above the lock state; the terminal guide instead keeps one concrete homogeneous orbit within absolute distance 19 above every earlier state of any finite r=1 segment. This sharpens candidate-specific decimal-phase certification but does not prove a uniform F(B) or F(M) tail bound.
